subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 629 189 586 643 746 (Right)

(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

If 2 is added to the first digit of every number, in how many numbers thus formed will the first digit be exactly divisible by the second digit?
solution:
Given series of three-digit numbers:

(Left) 629 189 586 643 746 (Right)

If 2 is added to the first digit of every number.

New Series: (Left) 829 389 786 843 946 (Right)

If 2 is added to the first digit of every number, in how many numbers thus formed will the first digit be exactly divisible by the second digit

New Series: (Left) __**829**__ 389 786 __**843 **__ 946 (Right).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
